notes.strategy: Walk-forward out-of-sample simulation, net of 10bps round-trip costs, with cash earning the prevailing T-bill rate.
notes.benchmark: SPY dividend-adjusted close, aligned to the strategy calendar.
notes.drawdown: Headline drawdown is month-end sampled; the daily-marks figure is published alongside it as max_drawdown_daily.
notes.sector_history: Point-in-time monthly positions of a reference configuration through mid-2026, then the model's recorded rebalances.
notes.live: Funded paper account. The plotted live series is rebased to continue the simulated curve; true dollar NAV is reported under 'live'.
notes.heatmap: Months after the backtest window are the funded account's own returns, measured from the $10,000 deposit, with SPY measured over the same window. Months flagged 'partial' are not full calendar months: the account joined its first month part-way through, and the latest month is still running.
notes.embargo: Active positions are embargoed for 7 days to protect live execution.
